cyd32-st7798.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 CYD 3.2 ST7798 R14.37 LAB — 362 RF Cases & Settings BACK
cyd32-st7798.summary: R14.37 LAB: 362 bounded BLE/Wi-Fi synthetic transmission cases with 220/220 upstream v1.50 static signature entries mapped to candidate on-air fixtures. Includes fork-only cases, OUI SoftAP MAC readback, bounded startup retry, and original test library. Settings DISPLAY page BACK returns to the first Settings page before Main Menu; Help, Identity and Recovery opened from Settings also return to the first page. Navigation is shared by landscape and portrait. No physical RF receiver compatibility claimed. SHA-256 multi-part flashing for CYD 3.2 ST7798.
highlights: 111 additional v1.50 Wi-Fi manufacturer-prefix SoftAP transmitters, individually selectable.
3 additional BLE service UUID advertisements; full FFFA Remote ID emission already available.
220/220 upstream static lookup entries mapped to candidate emissions; 362 total cases.
Active AP BSSID readback and bounded retry before reporting RF transmission.
10 fork-only OUI cases retained; case-unique MACs support expanded fixture library.
LAB only, physical receiver pass/fail unverified; no automatic RF transmission.
Settings submenu and DISPLAY page BACK routes corrected on landscape and portrait.

c5-waveshare-28.title: SquachEmit v1.1.0 Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8 R14.37 LAB — 362 Hardware RF Cases
c5-waveshare-28.summary: R14.37 LAB (boot catalog-count fix): 362 bounded synthetic on-air BLE/Wi-Fi cases. Added all 111 remaining v1.50 OUI-prefix SoftAP transmissions and 3 BLE UUID advertisements, preserving 10 fork-only cases and previous 238 fixtures. Hardware confirms active Wi-Fi AP MAC after startup; retries failed AP starts once. Upstream v1.50 source table mapping 220/220 candidate fixtures. Not a claim of complete parser/behavioral or physical receiver validation. SHA-256 multi-part flashing for Waveshare ESP32-C5 2.8.
highlights: 111 additional v1.50 Wi-Fi manufacturer-prefix SoftAP transmitters, individually selectable.
3 additional BLE service UUID advertisements; full FFFA Remote ID emission already available.
220/220 upstream static lookup entries mapped to candidate emissions; 362 total cases.
Active AP BSSID readback and bounded retry before reporting RF transmission.
10 fork-only OUI cases retained; case-unique MACs support expanded fixture library.
LAB only, physical receiver pass/fail unverified; no automatic RF transmission.
All three board boot banners now report the compiled scenario count rather than stale 172-case text.
